title: The Empty Circle
invitation: A surveyor is taking apart the dead signal box beside the road.

panels.text: At the relay, the little hammer rises and falls. Someone has jammed a brass token where the bell should ring.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: Ivo checks these boxes on his way home. He would never leave a road in the dark.

A line runs through the token’s open circle. The same scratch runs along the bent lamp wire. Rain hits the paper in Mara’s hand. There’s time to copy the mark or brace the wire while she closes the box.

choices.label: Trace the wire and make a rubbing of the token
choices.reply: Mara steadies the paper while you work. The dent on the token comes through beside the circle. She says the ore lift uses this stamp.

choices.label: Straighten the wire and get the signal lit
choices.reply: The lamp strikes a path through the fog. A walker with a limping partner follows it off the road. Mara waits until they are clear, then peers into the empty bolt hole. ‘Somebody took that bell on purpose.’

secret.title: Under the Dent
secret.hint: Keep a record of the token's face and the mark beside its circle.
secret.text: Tilt the rubbing under the lamp. The dent is a punch mark. Someone logged this relay as serviced after silencing its bell. Mara writes down where the token was found.
